name: lift
title: Lift
description: A field of small white containers, each holding a dark circle resting in its corner. The pointer pulls the circles toward it like a magnet, with a wide reach.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Lift /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Lift hover texture (textures.dev/s/lift)
